source.publisher: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations from the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (6 May 1939, p. 2).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1939. There was no change in personnel and no contest: the retiring member was the only nominee in twelve divisions and no nominations were received in the other eleven. Poll date Thursday 1 June 1939 (Ballymena Observer 2 Jun 1939 p. 5; BNL 4 May 1939 p. 13); filed under 1939-06-01, renamed from 1939-05-31 (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Added from reports of the new council's meetings early in the term, each division inferred from the previous return: Ballyclug, Dunminning, Glenravel, Kells, Kirkinriola, Longmore, Toome and Tullygarley. Returned unopposed.
